description: List the free learning hubs (phonics, sight words, tracing, math worksheets, grammar, reading comprehension, flashcards and classroom packs) with their pages, their Markdown twins, and the sets, topics, charts, skills, passages, decks or packs each one holds. Every one of those has a PDF link, printed at the level you pick (Easy unless you say). A reading passage or tracing sheet keeps its own level, a flashcard deck has none, and a classroom pack prints Challenge for Expert.

level.description: The level the PDF links print at. Easy when left out.
